content:wysiwyg_basic:2:71.name: WYSIWYG
content:wysiwyg_basic:2:71.html:
PATHWAY OF HOPE

Breaking the Cycle of Crisis Through Long-Term Support
 
Meeting your family's immediate needs is important. Building a brighter future is transformational. Pathway of Hope helps families with children overcome barriers, set achievable goals, and work toward lasting stability.
 
What Is Pathway of Hope?
 
Pathway of Hope is a Salvation Army initiative designed to help families with children move beyond crisis and achieve long-term stability. Through personalized case management and goal-focused support, families are empowered to address challenges related to income, employment, education, housing, and overall well-being. Our approach focuses on identifying strengths, building resilience, and creating a customized pathway toward lasting change.

content:wysiwyg_basic:4:96.name: WYSIWYG
content:wysiwyg_basic:4:96.html:
How Pathway of Hope Works

Assessment

  • Meet with a dedicated case manager to discuss your family's goals and challenges.

Goal Planning

  • Create a personalized action plan focused on long-term stability.

Support & Resources

  • Connect with services and community resources that support your journey.

Progress Tracking

  • Celebrate milestones and adjust goals as you move forward.

Lasting Stability

  • Build confidence, independence, and a stronger future for your family.

content:wysiwyg_basic:10:0.html:
Who Is Eligible?

Pathway of Hope is designed for families with children who are ready to work toward achieving long-term goals and increased self-sufficiency.

  • Families with dependent children
  • Individuals motivated to set and pursue goals
  • Families facing challenges related to housing, employment, education, or financial stability
  • Residents seeking long-term support beyond emergency assistance
Available Throughout Florida

Pathway of Hope is offered through participating Salvation Army locations across Florida. Families can connect with the nearest location to learn more about eligibility and available services.
